title: 🎨 Palette: Enhanced accessibility and discoverability for icon-only buttons
body:
💡 What: Added missing `aria-label` and `title` attributes to several icon-only buttons across the application (Sidebar, BuilderContainer, SovereignToolLauncher, UserKeyManager).
🎯 Why: Improves accessibility for screen reader users and provides hover tooltips for sighted users, making the interface more intuitive and discoverable.
♿ Accessibility: Ensures consistent use of `aria-label` and `title` on interactive elements, following the project's accessibility patterns.
